raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "pay for internet and electricity"
  role subject "Aigerim, Laila, Ruxandra and Noor"
  role object "1,600 EUR"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where match
    relation "pay"
    role subject ?who
    role object "1,600 EUR"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "be away"
    role subject "Noor"
    role time "half the year"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  where match
    relation "be fair"
    role subject "split equally"
    role topic "Noor was away for half the year"
    polarity affirmed
  end
